title: Number of Unequal Triplets in Array
summary: Given an array of positive integers, determine the count of unique triplets where each element in the triplet is distinct and no two elements are the same within the triplet.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, determine the count of unique triplets where each element in the triplet is distinct and no two elements are the same within the triplet.
constraints: Count index triples i<j<k whose three values are pairwise different.
Equal values at different indexes remain separate occurrences.
Return the number of valid triples.
hints: Process each value group as the middle value of a triple.
Multiply occurrences already processed, the current frequency, and occurrences in later groups.
Every three-value choice has one uniquely ordered middle group, so it is counted exactly once with all index multiplicities.
editorial: Every three-value choice has one uniquely ordered middle group, so it is counted exactly once with all index multiplicities.

tests.explanation: Choosing one of three fours together with two and three gives three unequal triplets.
No triple can contain three different values.
